tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (363)rgyun khyer dngos grub snye ma bzhugs so/(364)badzra ku ma ra la na mo/'dir phung pa mtsho rgyal lugs kyi yi dam nar mar sgrub pa la/lcags sam drag pa
(363)rgyun khyer dngos grub snye ma bzhugs so/(364)badzra ku ma ra la na mo/'dir phung pa mtsho rgyal lugs kyi yi dam nar mar sgrub pa la/lcags sam drag pa

tei:div.tei:p: (363)rgyun khyer dngos grub snye ma bzhugs so/ (364)badzra ku ma ra la na mo/

'dir phung pa mtsho rgyal lugs kyi yi dam nar mar sgrub pa la/ lcags sam drag po'i shing gi phur pa la brten nas sgrub pa la/ skyabs su 'gro ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// yi dam lha dang bla ma la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su 'chi// thugs rje che dang ldan pa yi// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa'i lha rnams la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// khyad par du yang slob dpon dang*// rig 'jin dam can bzhugs (365)so 'tshal// byang chub rdo rje lcam dral la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sems bskyed pani/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gzhaun nu'i rig 'dzin rnams// rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyong zhing*// srid gsum phur pa'i rang bzhin du// bsgom zhing sgrub par sems bskyed do/ /tshogs bsags pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam lha// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// pho brang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la/ lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// bla ma yi dam 'khor bcas la// bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnams sprul pa'i// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// tshe rabs thog med sngon rol nas// da lta'i lus blang yan (366)chad du// mi dge sdig pa'i tshogs rnams kun// dam tshig nyams gyur mthol la bshags/ ye rdzogs lha'i dkyil 'khor du// dus gsum bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin gyi// dge ba'i las rnams rdzogs bgyis pa// de dag kun la rjes yi rang*/ bdag cag 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// ma rig rmongs pa'i bag chags kyis// 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams pa la// thugs rjes chos 'khor bskor du gsol// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// tshogs pa'i rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ mched dang lcam dral 'dus pa kun// byang chub snying por rtag tu bzhugs// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kyis// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs// rdau rje sems dpa' yi dam lha// da lta nyid du mngon gyur shog

/mtshams bcad pa la/ bgegs kyi gtor ma 'bru gsum nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sngags rgyas bsngos te/ hūm̐/ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// gsang ba'i dam can so so nas// gdul ba la ni ma gtogs pa// kun kyang reb bskang zin gyis// da ltar nyid du so so dengs// ci ste bka' las 'das gyur na// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas ni// rdo rje'i mtshon chena'abar ba yi// thal ba bzhin du brlag par (367)bya/ /zhes brjod pas thugs ka nas yi ge hūm̐ ljang gu las rdo rje gnod sbyin ljang nag g.yas rdo rje gdengs pa/ g.yon bsdig mdzub can grangs med pa spros pas bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam ste rtsa sngags dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi'isngags brjod de/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gsal ba ni/ hūm̐/ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i// mtshon cha rnams pa sna tshogs kyis// dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin bsrung*// badzra tsakra hūm̐/ badzra ka la ru pa sha hūm̐/ na ṇa tsand+ra ma hā ro ṣa khad kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra karma sa twa ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa: rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri dang*// dbyug to rgya gram rnam pa lnga// rim pa bzhin du mtshams bcad pas// ci yang mi gnas cis mi shig /ces brjod/ dam bca' ni/ ho/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// bla med 'bras bu sgrub pa dang*// bde gshegs dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// rtse gcig yid kyis sgrub par bya// bdag kyang dus 'di man chad nas// byang chub snying po'i bar du ni// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams// mi 'da' ma 'grub par du bsrung*// yang dang yang du dam bcas pa// srog la bab kyang mi btang ngo*/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ gnas dang yo byad byin rlob ni/ hūm̐/ gdal ba chen po (368)chos dbyings pho brang nas// rdau rje 'dzin rgyal sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i rje// byin brlabs 'dod pa'i char chen 'beb mdzad pa/ phur pa grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas// rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// mthu dbang byin brlabs dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir// dbyings nas 'dir gshegs dkyil 'khor byin phob cig

/oṃ badzra ki li kī la sa pā ri wā ra badzra a we sha ya a a ā: ces dang*/ mchod pa byin gyi rlabs pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gi yi ge las// mchod rdzas dngos 'dzin bsreg gtor bkrus// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ swā hā/ 'phros pas bhandha'i snod nang du// 'bru gsum hrī bcas bzhu btul gyis// 'dod yon snang srid mchod pa'i sprin// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro// lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas su gyur// hūm̐ ā:oṃ hrīḥbhrum̐ badzra arghaṃ/ badzra pādyaṃ/ badzra puṣpe/ badzra dhu pe/ badzra ā lo ke badzra ghandhe/ badzra nai widya/ badzra shabda pra titstsha ho/ a/ thod pa snang srid kun khyab gzhal yas su// rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i byang sems 'khyil// 'od 'phros 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// bdud rtsir bkug (369)thim lha rnams bdud rtsir zhu// de las chu bur tshul du rta mgrin dbang*// yum bzhir bcas pa dbang gyur pa yang*// zhu bas kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing*// nus mthu phun sum tshogs bdud rtsi rgya mtsho ste// chos dbyigs nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa amṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ ā: bhandha stong gsum khyab pa'i snod nang du// nyon mongs 'gro ba bsgral ba'i rakta dang*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis mū la rakta dang*// mkha' dbyings rnam dag padma rakta dang*// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag chen rgya mtsho bskyil// ra las byung ba'i lha mo chags chen mo// 'bru gsum sbyor bas zhu nas bdud rtsi brlabs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ snang bsnod kyi 'jig rten ka pā lar// sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin ri ltar spungs// yi ge gsum gyis bzhus nas bdud rtsi brlabs// chos dbyings nam mkha'i mtha' klas gang bar gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzwa ba liṃ ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/

de yan chad kyis sngon 'argo'i chos rnams rdzogs so/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba yi// nam mkha'i dkyil (370)nas thig par shar// srog gi go ru shar ba dang*// snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ /zhes bsgom/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang las chos thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil ltar stong pa nyid du gsal ba las/ rang gi byang chub sems 'od kyi thig le dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin yi ge hūm̐ mthing ga bsam mo/ hūm̐/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni// bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te// phung po rdo rjes gtam byas nas// rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /zhes sems can thams cad kyi lus sems sku dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du rtogs te lhun gyi grub pa'i snying rje byang chub sems bskyed do/ hūm̐/ rgyu yi rig pa hūm̐ du shar// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud sbyangs// e yaṃ raṃ laṃ suṃ ra keṃ ba bhrum̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ pho brang gzhal yas khang gi gzhi// nam mkha' sngo skya gru gsum 'bar// ljang nag rdo rje'i rgya gram gtams// thams cad 'degs pa'i stobs dang ldan// me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar// khrag gi rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs// zhing chen smug po'i sa gzhi brdal// keng rus chen po'i ri rab la// rdo rje brag chen sra ba'i steng*// ba las dur khrod rab 'jigs kyi// dbus su ye shes gzhal yas khang*/ phyogs bcu rgya yongs ma chad pa'i// (371)phyi dang nang med kun tu snang*// rtsig pa pha gu dra phyed dang*// shar bu dang ni mda' yab mdzes// stegs bu 'dod yon lha mos gang*/ gru chad bzhi dang ldan pa ste// grub bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs mdzes// 'bar ba'i bar khyams gnyis dang ldan// thod sprul sna tshogs nyi zlas brjid// rgyan rnams kun gyis legs par brgyan// 'jigs pa'i khro bo mang po 'khrugs// phyi nang gnyis su ma dmigs kyang*// 'gags med ye shes rang snang la// nang ni dur khrod gzhal yas khang*// thod pa skam rlon rtsigs pa la// kun kyang mig nas me 'bar zhing*/

sna nas dud pa'i sprin phung 'thul// kha nas khrag gi zham chu 'bab// bar mtshams sha chen 'jin zhal byas// sa bdag pho mo ka gdan la// mchog chen brgyad kyi ka ba byas// nyi zla 'bar ba'i ka zhu la// tshangs pa'i gdung bzhi mig mang bris// zhing chen zhing chung dral phyam byas// zhing lpags thog dang blo bre la// rgyu rlon lda ldi don snying 'phyang*// keng rus thod tshal drwa bas brgyan// sgo bzhi sprul nag re gzhi la// nam mkha' lding dang rus sbal gyi// sgo yi ya them ma them byas// chu srin gdug pa'i lcib khung du// zhing gi lag pa'i (372)sgo leb byas// zhing chen rgyal mtshan phyogs bzhir bsgreng*/ g.yang gzhi rlon pas ba dan phyar// rgyu ma'i dar dpyang phyogs bcur g.yo// tsitta rlon pa'i tog gis mtshan// ye shes lnga yi me dpung 'bar// rdo rje 'bar ba'i rwa bas bskor// 'jigs pa'i dur khrode na po brgyad// gsar dang rnying pa'i ro yis gang*/ ro langs mang po gar byed cing*/ keng rus me 'bar rgyug dang 'khrab// gsal shing dag gis phug pa'i ro// shing la dpyang dang rings pa dang*// rul dang myags dang mes tshig dang*// mgo dang sha rus lhu dum 'thor// dur bya gshogs ldeb ci spyang 'thab// phyogs skyong zhing lha dang klu// 'dre dang sha za srin po dang*// 'jigs pa'ica co cher sgrogs cing*/ me chu shing dang mchod rten sprin// khrag mtsho khol ma zhag dang bcas// mkha' 'gro ma yis bdag byas shing*// rab 'jigs shin tu skyi g.ya' ba// grub pa'i rnal 'byor rgyu ba'i nas// 'bar ba brgyad kyis bskor ba yi// dkyil 'khor chen po lhun gyis grub// bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe bhañdza dzñā na tsakra maṇḍal bhrūm̐// de dbus mthing nag gru gsum e// zla gam khrag mtsho gsum dang ldan// 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu (373)pa// mu khyud thod pa'i rab bcas// dzaḥ rig pa hūm̐ gi yi ge las// 'bar ba khro bo'i 'phro 'du yis// lha chen dregs pa khyo shug dang*// phyogs skyong bcu po gdan du bting*/

/hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang thugs ka nas khro bo lcags kyu dang tho ba thogs pa mang po spros nas/ phyogs skyong bcu'i snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung*/ tho bas nyal gyis brdung nas dbus dang rtsibs bcur bzhag par bsam la/ paṃ padma maṇḍal/ a tsand+ra maṇḍal/ ma sūrya maṇḍal/ ma hā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wi dza: pra ha ma dzaḥ ind+ra dzaḥ agni dzaḥ ya ma dzaḥ ni ri ti dzaḥ wa ru ṇa dza: wa ya we dzaḥ ku bai ra dzaḥ i shwa dzaḥ bhu mi pā ti dzaḥ sa ra dzaḥ oṃ badzra kī li ki' la ya sarba bhighnan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod pas byang chub sems kyi thig le las snying rje chen po'i dbang dang*/ gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku dbang dang byin gyis brlabs pa yongs su rdzogs pa sku bskyed yin pas// lugs gzhan du lha bskyed nas dbang skur byin rlabs byed pa'i lugs ma yin pas/ hūm̐ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rigs 'dzin rnams// srid pa rdo rje 'grub mdzod cig /srid pa rdo rje phur bu'i lha// ye shes khro bo 'arub par mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// sku yi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig /thabs (374)kyi spyod pas 'gro don du// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad nas// dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces brjod pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur pa ni/ rgyu yi ting 'dzin yi ge hūm̐// rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur// de nyid dbus kyi gdan steng bab// 'od zer 'phro 'du don gnyis byas// snang stong rdo rje chos kyi sku// dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni// mthingag nag dkar dmar 'jigs pa'i zhal// rdo rje rtse gcig lnga g.yas// me dpung dang ni kha ṭwām̐ g.yon// mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril// rab 'jigs srin po khros pa'i gzugs// dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas dang ldan// rdo rje gshogs pa nam mkhar gdengs// dkar dmar mthing ga sbrul chen gyis// dbu rgyan se ral skyed ching dang*/

phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras// dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs// zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs dregs pa brdzis// ye shes bskal pa'i me dpung klong*// gar dgu'i nyams ldan dpa' bo che// thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems// rdo rje sems dpa' kunda'i mdog /rdo rje dang ni dril bu 'dzin// thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ dang ldan// mthing dmar kī la'i sngags (375)kyis bskor// thugs ni rin chen zur brgyad pa// zla gam gnam sgo gcig pa yi// sgo srung rta mgrin rgyal po gsal// bdag gi phung khams skye mched dang*// skra dang ba spu bcas pa kun// rang 'dra'i rdo rje gzhon nu ni// kī la ya yi sgra sgrog cing*// go mtshams med par gtams par gyur// oṃ tibta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: yum mchog rdo rje rgyas 'debs ma// 'khor lo thod khrag yab la 'khyud// gzig shams phyag rgya lnga yis spras// thod skam dbu rgyan do shal 'phyang*/ khro mo'i chas rnams rdzogs par gsal// thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// snod bcud gzhal yas lha ru gsal/ /ces dbang byin tshig rdzogs su bskyed zin nas/ de ni bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa zhes pa'o/ de nas phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil khor ni/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis su med pa las/ khro bcu'i sngags brjod sa bon gyi yi ge mi dgos par yab yum gyi dbang las bskyed kyang rung*/ byang chub kyi sems yi ge hūm̐ du gyur pa las bskyed kyang rungs ste/ khro bo rnams skad cig gis ting nge 'dzin du bskyed/ yum rnams lus dang grib ma'i tshul du byung bar bsgom/ phra men rnams lus dang yan lag gi tshul du bskyed tshul gyi rnam dbye nges par byas nas/ 'di ni rdzogs pa'i tshul yin te/ rim gyis bskyed pa'i tshulani sa bon (376) hūm̐ sbrel ma bcu yongs su gyur pa yab yum gnyisaka'i sngags kyis bskal bas/

khro bo yab yum bcu bskyed/ khro bo yab yum bcu las byang chub kyi sems yi ge dzaḥsogs ljang gu sbrel mar gyur pa las sprul pa'i phra men ma yab yum gyi gsang sngags kyis bskul ba las bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las// byang sems sprin 'phros 'gro rnasam bde la bkod// tshur 'dus gdan thog bcu ru thig le bcu// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig sbrel ma bcu// 'phros nas thig le bcu yi nang du zhugs// khro bo yab yum sprul par bcas pa gsal// hūm̐/ yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba las// byung ba'i phyogs bcu'i khro bo ni// thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa// spyan dgu zhabs kyang bzhi pa ste// dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis brgyan// rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs ka ru// rdo rjes dung dmar dkrug cing gsol// mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa bsgril// btsun mo 'jigs pa'i tshogs dang 'khril// oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pa 'di ltar yab sngags kyis khro bo yab dang*/ hūm̐ zhes pas yum bskyed/ gardza'i sngags kyis phra men gnyis bskyed/ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa de dag bskul te gdan la 'khod par bsam/ 'og ma rnams la byor/ steng phyogs rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad (377)sngo// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar sgra 'byin yum// bar pa'i phyag gnyid mda' gzha 'geng*/ sprul pa phag dang rtsang ba'i mgo oṃ badzra kro dha bhi dza ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa// shar phyogs khro bo rnam par rgyal// dkar dmar sngo zhing snyem ma yum// bar ma'i phyag nyis 'khor lo 'dzin// sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo oṃ badzra kro dha ni la tant+ra hūm̐/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lho khro bo dbyug sngon sngo// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar sder mo yum// bar pa dbyug to me dpung ba rnams// sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo oṃ badzra kro dha yamānta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho ru gshin rje'i gshed po mthing*// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dur khrod yum// bar pa dgra st+wa dbyug to 'dzin// sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo oṃ badzra kro dha ārya a tsa la hūm̐/ bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub khro bo mi g.yo smug /g.yas dkar g.yon ljang gtun khung yum// bar pas ral gri zhag pa 'dzin// sprul pa gzigs dang khā ta'i mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub tu khro bo rta mgrin dmar// g.yas dkar g.yon sngo gtum mo yum// bar pa ral gri sbrul zhags 'dzin// sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo oṃ badzra (378)kro dha a pa ra tsitta hūm̐/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang khro bo 'dod rgyal dmar// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar mda' snyem yum// bar pa dbyug to rnga yab 'dzin// sprul pa spyang ki khra yi mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha amṛ ta kunḍa li hūm̐/ tsindha tsindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang*// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rlalung 'byin yum// bar pa rdo rje dbyug to 'dzin// sprul pa seṅge pha waṃ mgo

/oṃ badza kro dha tre lo kya bhi dza ya hūm̐/ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar khro bo bgegs 'dul ser// g.yas mthing g.yonaljang gsod byed yum// bar pa rdo rje tri shul 'dzin// sprul pa dred dang sre mong mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā bā la hūm̐/ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og phyogs stobs chen dud kha'i mdog /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rigs byed yum// bar pas tho ba gtun shing 'dzin// sprul pa dom dang byi la'i mgo /yab rnams cha lugs gtso dang mthun// yum rnams sku mdog yab dang mtshungs// cha lugs gtso bo dag dang mthun// phyag mtshan dril bu dung dmar 'dzin// sprul pa lcam dral sku mdog ni// g.yas g.yon zhal gyi kha dog 'dzin// phyag mtshan sna tshogs phur bu thog /dzaḥ shar phyogs sgo ma pu shud mgo mthing (379)ga g.ya pa lcags kyu 'dzin// hūm̐ḥ lho yi sgo ma skya ga'i mgo ser po g.yas pas zhags pa 'dzin// baṃḥ nub kyi sgo ma srin bya'i mgo dmar nag g.yas pas lcags sgrog 'dzin// hoḥ byang gi sgo ma khra yi mgo ljang nag g.yas pas dril bu 'dzin// kun kyang g.yon pas phur bu 'dzin// kun kyang cha lugs gcer bu la// gyad kyi sham thabs sked par dkris/ /de nas dam can 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ pho brang gzhal yas phyi rol du// khrag khyams zhing skam gdan steng du// dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu brgyad// smug nag ser nag dmar nag dang*// ljang nag bdun re phyogs bzhir bskyed// khrag khyams phyi rol lha snams gnyis// mi ro rta ros gang ba'i steng*// nang der phur srung bcu gnyis dang*// phyi rol ming po ging rnams gsal// shar sgor dung gi skyes bu dang*// lho sgor lcags kyi skyes bu dang*/ nub sgor bse yi skyes bu dang*/ byang sgor ṭa ki nag po bskyed// gzhal yas bar khyams 'khor yug la// ma mo chen mo sum cu gnyis// ging chen pho mo bco brgyad dang*// 'bar ba'i pho nya ma mo bdun// srin bzhi brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*// dge bsnyen (380)nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams// 'khor bcas ma 'dres yongs rdzogs bskyed/

/de nas phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ e spha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ nṛ tri dzaḥ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ phur gdan chos 'byung 'bar ba ru// srid gsum gdug pa kun bkug nas// gan rgyal kha sbug 'gyel bar gyur/ /phur pa la yungs kar gtor nas/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya badzra yakṣa kro dha tshal pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gzi mdangs bskyed/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya rdu be ta li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug pas thugs shintu khro zhing ba spu'i grangs kyi khro chung gis gtams par bsam/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal dgra bgegs ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rakta byugs pas thugs rjes gzhan don du chags par bskyed do/ de nas phur pa gdan la bkod de/ hūm̐/ tibta tsakra phur pa'i lha// mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can// sku stod khro bo chen po la// lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbal// 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od// phyag bzhi g.yas na st+wa re dang*// rdo rje ri rab gnon stabs 'dzin// kha ṭwām̐ bshol bas khams gsum 'jig /phur bu btab pas ngan song stong*// khyod kyi stobs dang drag rtsal ni// khro rgyal kun las khyad par che// dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs// (381)thugs la rdo rje gzhon nu gsal// ye shes me dpung klong na bzhugs// drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste// btab na lha yang brlag gyur na// gnod byed rnams la smos caci dgos// dgra bgegs snying la kī la ya/ /zhes che ba brjod nas phur gdan la bkod do/ dgos pa ni dngos grub myur du 'byung ba dang*/ dbang myur ba dang*/ phrin las myur ba dang*/ bar chad sel nus pa'i phyir shin tu gal che'o/ rgyud las/ ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gsum la srog ye shes su dbang bskur ces pa'ang yin/ bdag rtsa ba dang*/ phur pa rdzas la sngar gyi des go chod pas mi dgos la/

khro bcu yab yum khra thabs sgo ma dang bcas pa rnams kyi gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis mtshan par bsam mo/ de dag gis don gyi man ngag gi 'khrugs sdeb gsungs pa'i don yin no/ de nas spyan drangs pa la/ bdag bskyed gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi (382)gnas nas rdo rje gzhon nu la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba phur pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs bar mos te/ thod phreng gi phyag rgya smin mtshams su bcings/ thal mo brdab cing snying po brjod la/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir// ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol// khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang*// rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ e hya hi bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka drishya hoḥ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ ru lu ru lu pheṃ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs te/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ srid gsum gdug pa 'dul ba dang*// nga rgyal zhen pa gzhom pa'i phyir// rdo rje srin po 'khor bcas la// rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū ho/ pra titstsha ho/ zhes dang bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa pā ri wā ra hasta tsa (383)pa dyaṃpra titstsha swā hā/ badzra a sa na pra ti tiṣṭha ntu/ zhes zhabs bsil nas gdan la bzhugs/ ma hā pū dza ho: zhes mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim mo/ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal gnyis 'khrugs brdeb 'di bzhin nges dgos so/ de nas/ bdag gi thugs ka'i yi ge las sprul pa'i rigs lnga he ru kas bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur bar mos te/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rje btsun ye nas yin pa'i phyir// sku gsung thugs su byin rlabs shing*// ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur ro/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ 'khor gyi la thams cad la gtso bos dbu brgyan cing*/ dam can phur srung gi tshogs rnams la dbang rtags rdo rje phyed pas mtshan par gyur/ phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐/ mchod yon zhabs bsil bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil/ lha rdzas me tog sa dang bar snang khyab/ spos kyi dud sprin gnam sa bar kun 'khrigs// mar me phreng bas stong gsum 'od kyis gsal// spos chu'i rdzing bu snang srid kun tu bskyil// zhal zas bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis stong khams gang*// lha mi'i rol mo sgra snyan srid gsum 'khrol// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po 'dis// rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig /oṃ badzra ki li kī la ya sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ pra titstsha hoḥ de bzhin du pādyaṃ sogs nas (384)shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod ni/ hūm̐/ khams gsum rnam dag dur khrod gnas mchog tu// dbang po lnga yi me tog ri ltar spungs// gsur chen dud pa'i sprin phung kun nas 'khrigs// zhun chen mar me dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar// mchog chen zhag gi byugs pa mtsho ru 'khyil// sha chen bdud rtsi'i zhal zas 'jig rten gang*/ srid gsum khyab pa'i keng rus brag ltar 'tsher// ko ro tsa nas nam mkha'i rgya khyon bkang*// rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra gdangs 'brug ltar sgrogs// dpag yas nang gi mchod pa bla na med// rol pa ye shes rdzas kyi mchod pa 'di// dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i lha la 'bul// oṃ ma hā rakta kiṃ nga ni ri ti ma hā pañtsa pū dza hoḥ 'dod yon lha mos mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gzugs kyi lha mo yid 'ong ma// dkar mo mdzes ma me long 'dzin// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ spyan gyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /sgra yi lha mo= ser mo dbyangs snyan pi waṃ 'dzin// dkyil 'khor= snyan gyi mchod pas= dri yi lha mo yid 'ong ma// sngon mo mdzes ma spos phor 'dzin// dkyil 'khor=

shangs kyi mchod= ro yi lha mo= dmar mo mdzes ma zhal zas 'dzin// dkyil 'khor = ljags kyi mchod= reg bya'i lha mo (385)ljang gu pañtsa li ka 'dzin// dkyil 'akor= /sku yi mchod pas= /chos kyi lha mo= /mthing ga chos kyi 'byung gnas 'dzin// dkyil 'khor = /thugs kyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /oṃ badzra kī lī ki la ya sa pā ri swā ra rū pa shabda gandhe ra sa sparshe dharmā ka ma gu ṇa pū dza hoḥ gar gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ sku mdog zhal ni rab bsgyur zhing*/ sku yi gar stabs glog 'gyu bas// 'bar ba'i khro bo mnyes bya ste// phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul// lha rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams gsal btab ste/ gsang mchod ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas gzungs ma rigs lnga spros te lha tshogs rnams la dgyes par 'khril bas bde stong gis mchod par bsam la/ hūm̐/ rdau rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la// pad can dung can glang sna can// ri dwags can dang sna tshogs gzugs// yid 'ong phyag rgya'i mchod pa 'bul// 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor bas// bdag nyid mnyes pas mnyes par mchod// sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a nu ra ga ya ho/ a nu ra ga ya mye/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ bo dhi tsitta spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces rnal 'byor lcam dral rnams nang gi mchod pas mnyes par bya'o/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i (386)rdzas// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// rgyal kun ngo bo bla ma rje// phur pa rgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dpal chen phur pa'i dkyil 'khor la// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje dbang dang dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta la kha hi/ ka ya wākka tsitta siddhi pha la hūm̐/ /mched lcam chang la rol/ rakta ni/ hūm̐/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas// dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru// zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas/

dmar gyi arghaṃ rgya mtsho bskyil// mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas kyis// ma lus bzhes nas bsnams su gsol// sarba duṣṭaṃ ru tra mā ra ya kha kha khā hi kha hi/ sgrol mchod ni/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ sprul pa chen po'i = phyag brnyen chen mo'i = bdag nyid chen mo'i = sa bdag chen mo'i = shā na mu kha'i = /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams// khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis// yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la// mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*// lus ngag rdu du bshig nas kyang*// sdug bsngal nyams su (387)myong bar mdzod// oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan/ mo ha ga ta ya bha ga wān/ shri kri ni kri badzra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ badzra kī li ki la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sarba bhignan badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsgral la gtor ma bran/ dmar sbreng la/ ma hā maṃ sa rakta tsitta ba su ta keṃ ni ri ti go ro tsa na kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ces bstab bo/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dpal chen che ba'i che mchog lha yi lha// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi// phrin las thams cad rdzogs pa'i dpal chen po// he ru dpal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs byed 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba// sku gsum ma rdzogs pa'i khro rgyal phur pa'i lha// srid rtsa'i bdag 'dzin ru tra sde gsum 'dul// dpal chen phrin las rdzogs la = /gtum chen brjid pa 'gying zhing sgeg pa'i sku// bdud tshogs sde bcas 'dul ba'i dpa' bo che// mi sdug srin po khros 'dra'i cha lugs kyis// srid gsum gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod// bzhad sgra 'brug stong ldir 'dra'i gad rgyang can// drag shul chen pos ri rab thal bar brlag /'jigs rung rtsal gyis khams gsum dus gcig bsgral// dpal chen khro bo'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod// snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig chen po yis// (388)'gro kun byang chub snying por 'dren mdzad pa// thugs rje dbyings nas khros pa'i stangs stabs kyis// 'khor ba gtan nas brlag byed khyod la bstod// gdug can drag po 'dul ba nyer dgongs nas// 'bar ba'i khro tshul du ma'i gar mdzad kyang*// chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang las mi g.yo ba// dpal chen mngon rdzogs rgyal po khyod la bstod// nam mkha'i khams kun yongs su khyab pa'i sku// gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla gza' skar yang*// sku yi rgyan du che ba'i dpal chen po// che btsan 'gran zla bral ba khyod la bstod// hūm̐/

'jigs pa'i btsun mo 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma// kun tu bzang mo dkyil 'khor kun gyi yum// gdug pa 'dul phyir srin mo khros pa'i gzugs// srid pa'i 'khor lo ye shes rgyas 'debs ma// gnyis med don ldan yab la dgyes par 'khril// phyag g.yas 'khor los bdud kyi mgo lus gshogs// g.yon pas thod khrag 'khor 'das dbang du sdud// 'jigs pa'i sku la phyag rgya lnga yis spras// drag po'i nga ros 'jig rten g.yo zhing 'khrugs// rgyud lnga'i sems can thugs rjes dbyings su sgrol// srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs rnams thal bar rlog /mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso mo khyod la bstod// hūm̐/ phyogs bcu dregs pa (389)bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i sku// 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i khro rgyal chen po bcu// mi dge bcu spangs dge bcu rdzogs pa'i sku// kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug gtum la rngams// phyogs skyong dregs pa pho mo thams cad 'dul// dbu skra ral pa srid pa'i rtse mor 'bar// mi sdug khro gnyer smin mtshams g.yo ba can// spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mimag phyogs bcur gzigs// log par lta ba rtsad nas gcod cing sgrol// mche ba zang yag skye shi rtsad nad gcod// gdug pa 'dul mdzad 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan bsnams// dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du che// rdo rje rin chen gshogs pa nam mkhar gdengs// rngams pa'i zhal gdangs ljags 'dril skan sgra rdeg /kun kyang phur pa 'dril zhing phyogs bcur 'debs// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med yum dang 'khril// g.yas g.yon dag tu sprul pa khra thabs ni// mgo brnyan mche gshog rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs ldan// 'bar ba'i khro rgyal ma bcos rdzogs pa'i sku// sgra las 'das pa drag po hūm̐ sgra'i gsung*// bsam las 'das pa sgrol byed snying pa'i ngang*// yon tan phrin las thams cad rdzogs pa'i dpal// sprul pa chen (390)po rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/

gnyis med sku la 'khril ba'i gzungs mchog ma// rngam brjid 'jigs pa khro mo'i cha lugs can// pha rol phyin pa bcu yi ngo bo nyid// bdud 'dul yum gyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ rdo rje gdong mo pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi// dgra bgegs gdug pa 'gugs mching sdom zhing rdeg /shar lho nub byang sgo srung drag shul can// sgo ma chen mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor na// dpal gyi sras mchog 'jigs byed kī la ya// mthing nag khros pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// phyag g.yas dang pas st+wa re phrag par phyar// 'og mas rdo rje'i ri rab mnan stabs 'dzin// g.yon pa'i dang pos kha ṭwām̐ rtse gsum 'khrol// 'og ma'i phur bus dgra bgegs snying la 'debs// rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog hūm̐ du 'bar// snyan nas 'brug sgrog spyan nas me 'od 'phro// shangs nas rlung 'tshub zhal nas thog ser 'beb// mche ba gtsigs shing ag tshome ma ltar 'bar// khyod kyi lte ba man chad chas rnams ni// lcags phur zur gsum me stag phyogs bcur 'phro// dgra bgegs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams skad cig sgrol// mi (391)g.yo che mchog sku gsung thugs kyi ngang*/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// srid par 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad kun// thabs kyis bsgral ba'i skal dang mi ldan yang*/ shugs kyis bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzad slad du// dbyer med sku gsung thugs su sgrol mdzad pa// sras mchacog kī la ya la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/ces bstod/ de nas bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi sning mchong gur phub pa'i dbus su nyi zla'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' */ de'i thugs tsitta smug po gur phub pa'i gzhal yas khang du zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dgu pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing spus bris pa tsam/ de'i tha ma la nyi chung dang zla chung spel ba'i steng du/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bhignan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags phreng 'od ljang dmar du gsal ba btab/ mdun du sras mchog gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing ga gsal/ bdag khro bo'i go tshogs dang bcas pas sngags bzlas pas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer yig 'bru'i tshul du byung nas mtha' bskor gyi 'bru brgyud nas rdo rje'i rtse nas ye shes sems dpa'i sna bug g.yas pa nas tsitta'i gnam skar nas brgyud/ bdag gi sna bug g.yas pa nas sras mchog gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ mnyes mchod phul slar byung nas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag par bsam la rtsa sngags bzla'o/ de nas (392) mgar gyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba'i tshul du bzla ba ni/ bdag khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pas sngags bzlas pas 'od zer me stag gi tshul du 'phros pas/ dgra bgegs thams cad bya sgro me la bsreg pa ltar tshig par bsam la/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ rakmo yakmo kā la ru pa/ snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ srog la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying la phril phril/ srog la chum chum/ tsitta srog la gtung gtung*/ saṃ tri rag thib thib tsa tri sa ma tri snying kha rag dun tri nan shig shig saṃ na gtub gtub/ thuṃ rili li tsig tsig 'ur 'ur shig shig gul gul myag myag sod sod dha ti ma ma karma shri krang ga ro ya/ ma ra sa na pra ma rta na ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces khri 'bum bzla'o/ mkhar chen bza' nas lang lab byang chub rdo rje la bka' babs pa bka' yi chung gi man ngag yang dag pa'o/ thun mtshams su tshogs mchod phul ba ni/

tshogs rdzas bzang zhong gya noms pa bshams te/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid dpal chen thugs ka nas// 'byung ba'i yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ// 'phros pas tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin dang*/ ma dag dri ma bsreg gtor bkrus// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ma su rya maṇḍal/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams kyi steng*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor hūm̐ mthing mtshan// de gnyis 'od du thim pa las// dag pa chos dbyings ngang du brlabs// paṃ padma maṇḍal la/ padma'i steng du āḥdamar po// 'od (393)zhu thim pas bdud rtsir gyur// a tsand+ra maṇḍal// zla ba oṃ dkar 'od du thim// 'dod yon lnga yis gang bar gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras// khro bo'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// lha dang lha min rnal 'byor pa// thugs dang 'thad pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// dam tshig tshul bzhin gshegs su gsol// badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ tshogs tsho gsum du bcad la/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ snang srid thams cad phur pa'i lha// rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la// 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// ma hā ga ṇa tsakra kha hi/ ma hā dza gad kha hi// ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta sarba pū dza ho/ bar bshags ni/ hūm̐/ thog med dus nas da ltar thug gi bar/ ma rig dbang gis dam las 'gal gyur te// lus kyi sdig byas spyod pa ngan par spyod// ngag gi tshig gis smra ba ngan du brjod// sems kyis blo nor logs par bsam la sogs// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa// bkra ba'i lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol/ /ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ 'gugs bstim byas te/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ (394)sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab// bdag nyid chen mo'i = /sa bdag chen mo'i = /shwa na mu kha'i= /bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la babs// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i// rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni// gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams// khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyi// yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la// mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*// lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang*// sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod// oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan/

badzra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ bdud dang bar du gcod pa'i bgegs// sdug bsngal sems la mnyam sbyor ba'i// dgra bgegs che ge zhes bya ba// zungs shig chings shig rnam par chings// gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis// ring bar khug la smrar chug cig /phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis// nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang*// bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis// hūm̐ pa ra bi dan tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gṛhna grihna hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ trā sa ya trā sa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ has ya ra ha sa ya ra hrīḥdaṇṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ shrī kri a na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dzwa la ya dzwa la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ a be (395)sha ya a be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs// khyed kyi dam tshig dus la babs// sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pa'i// mngon spyod phrin las tshul bzhin mdzod// ha na ha na badzra/ da ha da ha badzra/ pa tsa pa tsa badzra/ ma tha ma tha badzra/ dzwa la dzwa la badzra/ su ru su ru badzra/ mu ru mu ru badzra/ ka ṭa ya ka ṭo ya dza ye bi dza ye/ a dzi te/ a pa ra dzi te/ mā ra sya na pra ma rta na ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni// sdig can gang zhig mda' byed na// stobs chen khro bo chen po yis// klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos// nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed// hūm̐ ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ma taṃ nya ka ra i dan dha ti ma ma shri ghraṃ ka ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ gdug pa'i sdang sems ldan pa rnams// zungs shig lha min lha yang rung*// nga la bar chad byed pa rnams// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med pa byos// sarba a nan ye hūm̐ phaṭa// ta tha ya ta tha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdung shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun// bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams// rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg nas// lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brdung*// khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du// rdo rje tho bas brdung byas te// lha yang rung ste brlag par bya// kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ/

(396)hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bsgral/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen pa'i dus la babs// rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang*// sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams// dug gsum dgra bgegs zhal du stob// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā maṃ sa rakta tsitta ba su ta keṃ ni ri ti ko ro tsa na kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ces bstan nas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs// khyod kyi dam tshig dus la babs/ sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs pa// lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// mngon spyod phrin las tshul bzhin mdzod// u tsiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi/ bskul pa ni/ hūm̐/ phur pa rol pa'i dur khrod nas// rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams// srid pa rdo rjer 'grub mdzod cig /snang srid thams cad phur pa'i lha// ye shes khro bo 'grub par mdzod/ /ces bskul lo/ bka' yi chad mdo bsgrags pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba// dpal chen badzra kī la yas// dregs pa sde gsum bsgral ba'i tshe// bka' nyan ma mo'i nyi shu brgyad// de yi 'khor du gtogs pa rnams// rdo rje'i rigs su dbang bskur nas// dkyil 'khor gcig tu byinarlabs pas// (397)ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa// da lta rig 'dzin bdag bskul na// gang bcol las kun 'grub par mdzod/ /brtan ma ni/ hūm̐/ rten 'brel dus sbyor gnas dag pa'i// bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis po// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /mnan pa ni/ e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs kyis// glu bro gar gyi phyag rgya yis// ma dag srid pa rdul du bshig /srid pa ye shes rgyas btab pas// thams cad ye shes dbyings su grol/ st+wambha ya nan/ slar yang mchod cing bstod nas dngos grub blang ba ni/

ho/ sdom la gnas shing rig 'dzin sgrub pa pos// yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams// dang pa brten cing smon lam gcig tu btags// bar du bsnyen cing sgrub pa tshul bzhin bgyis// da ltar bsnyen sgrub las kyi skabs sbyar bas// dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la da babs na// rdo rje gsum dang tshe dang mngon spyod kyi// dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsal du gsol/ /rtsa sngags dang*/ ka ya wākka tsitta gu ṇa karma sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐/ ces dngos grub blang ngo*/ de nas bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas snod bcud lhar gsal ba 'od du zhu nas (398)bdag la thim/ yum yab la thim/ de thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ mi dmigs pa 'od sal stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag slar yang*/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ 'od gsal gyi ngang las rlung sems las grub pa'i lha sku sgyu ma ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur// bsngo ba dang smon lam mtha' rgyas su bya'o// gu ru'i thugs dam rod rje phur pa 'di// thugs la gab pa mtsho rgyal nyid la gdams// rim par brgyud pa'i bka' bab lang lab kyi// gsang ba'i man ngag 'di las yod re kan// rgyal sras dharmā pā ti'i bkas bskul nas// rgyud dang man ngag shin tu zab pa las// padma las 'brel rtsal gyis 'bad pas bsdus// dge bas lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu yis// tshe rab kun tu rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /mchog thun dngos grub rnams gnyis myur thob nas// mthu stobs mngon spyod phrin las rtsal rdzogs nas// bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'ang skyabs rje 'jigs bral gling pa'i gdung sras dharmā pa ti'i thugs bzhes su phur pa'i rgyud dang man ngag lam du goms pa padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs su gyur cig //
